title: The comment directly above the only entry goes with it when it is removed
notes: A comment on the line directly above an entry, with no blank line between, goes with it (docs/edit-semantics.md, Comments); `edit/remove-key-with-comment-directly-above` says so for a middle entry, and a first entry with another one after it behaves the same. Nothing changes when the entry is also the only one: the comment goes and the emptied root is written `{}`. The exact bytes rest on a kit convention (docs/edit-semantics.md).

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the native backend wrote `{}`, the pure backend kept `# head` above it; with a second entry both dropped the comment.
